presets.label: EAGLE-3 · Llama-3.1-8B
presets.note: Self-drafting head, draft cost tiny. Real-world per-token acceptance lands in the 0.6-0.8 band, below the near-1.0 used in theory (BentoML, 2026).

presets.label: Domain-aligned drafter
presets.note: A draft model tuned to the workload accepts long runs; the regime the original speculative-decoding result reported on T5 (Leviathan et al., 2023).

presets.label: Off-the-shelf draft
presets.note: A generic small model on out-of-distribution prompts: acceptance collapses and speculation barely beats plain autoregressive decoding.

presets.label: VIA-SD multi-tier
presets.note: A routed slim-verifier rescues medium-confidence rejects, cutting rejection rates 0.10-0.22 over strong SD baselines (arXiv 2606.12243).
